messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered PD-48291 — p99 latency > 4s for route /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (threshold 2s). Link: https://pagerduty/PD-48291 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-48291 assigned to on-call (Maya R). Severity: P1. Incident page: https://pagerduty/PD-48291

Maya R: acked. I'm on it. Quick numbers: p95 went 0.9s -> 1.8s, p99 1.2s -> 4.5s. Spike started ~03:12Z. Region: eu-west-1 only. No bulk 5xx spike, but serving queue lengths are high. :thinking_face:

Huan T: seeing a lot of sidecar evictions and KV cache misses around 03:13Z — logs show repeated reconnects. Snippet:
```
[03:13:01] sidecar: evicted shard 27 due to mem-pressure
[03:13:03] model-worker[42]: kvcache miss key=usr:prompt:... latency 21ms
[03:13:06] router: queue_depth=48 avg_dispatch=120ms
```

Samir P: any deploys around 03:10Z? CI shows a canary push to /v1/generate at 03:08Z for xlarge-v2-quant. If rollback is cheap, that could help isolate.

Maya R: rolling back canary now. Running:
```
infractl rollout cancel --route /v1/generate --canary xlarge-v2-quant
infractl pool scale --name eu-west-gen-1 --delta 2
```
Scaling +2 instances to relieve queue.

oncall-rotation: pinging infra for instance spin-up ETA.

Ops Lead: heads-up — start CS outreach for top EU customers. Potential SLA impact. @Customer Success Bot please queue notifications.

Customer Success Bot: Notifying top-5 EU customers now, email template queued. :email:

pagerduty-bot: PD-48291 acknowledged by Maya R (maya@pagerduty). Escalation level: P1.

Alex R: starting KV cache flush for hotkey range 0-255 to clear thrash:
```
kvtool flush-range --pool eu-west-gen-1 --range 0-255
```
Watching cache fill.

Maya R: after rollback + scale: p99 down to ~2.1s, queue_depth falling. Still occasional spikes tied to shard recovery. Suggest temp traffic split to fallback model (small cost) to avoid tail.

Huan T: applying routing split now:
```
routerctl route-split --route /v1/generate --weights '{"xlarge-v1":0.9,"xlarge-fallback":0.1}' --tag temp
```
Applying.

incident-bot: PD-48291 escalated to Level 2 (Ops Lead) due to customer-impact threshold exceeded.

Samir P: ACME_CORP (enterprise) saw ~12% requests >3s between 03:12-03:22Z. Ops Lead — recommend proactive outreach.

Ops Lead: starting proactive outreach and drafting customer note. Also opening follow-up ticket to investigate sidecar eviction thresholds and memory behavior.

Maya R: monitoring. Will wait 15m for stability, then hand off to next on-call.

oncall-rotation: I'm taking 03:30Z->11:30Z. Will check in at +15m. If we need voice, start a bridge and tag me.

Alex R: cache flush finished. Metrics updating: kv_hit_rate 78% -> 92% over 6m. Fill looks healthy.

Maya R: p99 stable at ~1.1s, p95 ~0.85s. Recommend marking incident mitigated but keep open for follow-up actions.

pagerduty-bot: PD-48291 status updated: mitigated by Maya R. Please add notes to the incident page.

Ops Lead: Follow-ups (owners):
- Investigate sidecar eviction triggers (owner: Huan T)
- Review canary health checks / rollout thresholds (owner: Samir P)
- Add automated cache warming for heavy shards (owner: Alex R)
- Customer postmortem & outreach (owner: Ops Lead / CS)
Meeting scheduled tomorrow 10:00 CET for RCA.

Maya R: uploading timelines, graphs, and logs to the incident page. Thanks team. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for now. If metrics regress PD will re-fire.
